scope: Design cases only, all UNRUN. Nonce-group recovery accounting qualifies before a second community shares the sender. Successor specification is a separate proposal, not implementation/adoption or a main operator rollout gate.

cases.scenario: Manually admitted test wallet and existing action-specific authorization permit only its listed community/install/namespace/action
cases.assertion: Independent signature, pilot-list revision and actual contract authority verified; no general membership store or operator-app assertion required

cases.scenario: Compromised community Worker asserts another community or wallet; valid app credential cannot authorize it
cases.assertion: Refusal before reservation/signing; neither budget changes

cases.scenario: Expired/revoked action authorization, role, challenge or pilot admission after an awaited read
cases.assertion: Revalidation prevents signing; reservation retained/released only under proven no-effect rule

cases.scenario: Extra keys, LF/CRLF/Unicode suffixes, noncanonical decimals/addresses and mutable request during await
cases.assertion: Closed immutable reconstruction or refusal; original digest never changes

cases.scenario: Batch contains permitted call plus disallowed pre-call/fund transfer/delegation/fee recipient/domain
cases.assertion: Whole request refused; target allowlist alone never sufficient

cases.scenario: Two users contend for last community fee headroom
cases.assertion: Exactly one reservation; global/community/user/journal updated atomically

cases.scenario: Two communities contend for last global fee headroom
cases.assertion: Exactly one reservation across both communities in the same object

cases.scenario: Inject throw halfway through transaction and durability failure before signer call
cases.assertion: No partial counters; signer and broadcaster invocation count zero

cases.scenario: Duplicate same logical operation/final intent versus same logical ID with changed bytes
cases.assertion: Same reservation returned for equal; conflict for altered; no second liability

cases.scenario: Ledger/policy epoch changes or global pause while fee estimation awaits
cases.assertion: Stale reservation authority cannot sign; no silently reset outstanding liabilities

cases.scenario: Unknown extra data-fee cap or amount above cap despite low transaction count
cases.assertion: Refuse before authorization; count allowance is not fee cap

cases.scenario: User rate-limit exhaustion with ample fee balance and community fee exhaustion with low count
cases.assertion: Each independent restriction enforced without partial updates

cases.scenario: Signer succeeds but reply is lost; gateway retries same operation
cases.assertion: Exact original signer journal used; no new nonce/signature identity or optimistic refund

cases.scenario: Broadcast succeeds but RPC times out
cases.assertion: Unknown original stays reserved; no automatic resend/new request; exact receipt recovery

cases.scenario: Raw transaction A paired with hash B and matching enrollment/claim
cases.assertion: Refuse; recomputed immutable original hash used through all awaits

cases.scenario: Receipt missing, safe block lagging or canonical block unavailable
cases.assertion: Unknown/unavailable result, retained reservation, no latest fallback

cases.scenario: Receipt/event appears then block is orphaned before safe confirmation
cases.assertion: No final settlement; orphaned projection invalidated; original operation retained

cases.scenario: Safe revert or success with missing fee semantics
cases.assertion: Revert gas charged; unresolved fee upper bound retained rather than released

cases.scenario: Restore journal to before a signed authorization/spend while external signer fence is newer
cases.assertion: All signing remains paused; reconstruct both spent and unbroadcast liability

cases.scenario: External outbox missing or old valid MOSS signature has not been broadcast
cases.assertion: No recovery-complete claim from chain receipts alone; no epoch budget reset

cases.scenario: Client repeats a renewal through backend and MOSS routes
cases.assertion: One logical-operation reservation; unsupported alternate route refused

cases.scenario: Initialized account signs exact nested ClaimAcceptance; actual claimFreeName executes _safeMint
cases.assertion: Permanent matching claimReceipt/event, correct holder, ERC1271 and receiver path evidenced

cases.scenario: Fresh no-code account signs same nested consent
cases.assertion: Record actual chain result; helper verification alone is failure to establish compatibility; no implicit activation

cases.scenario: Alter each claim field and chain/verifying-contract domain after signing
cases.assertion: Every altered claim refused; issuer FreeClaim digest semantics unchanged

cases.scenario: Sponsored holder record/transfer or controller configure
cases.assertion: Target sees authorized wallet as msg.sender; exact effects and actual payer debit proven

cases.scenario: Merchant defaults, explicit client mode and unsigned intent manipulation
cases.assertion: No default sponsor:true; independent actor proof and final payer/domain/fee digest checked

cases.scenario: Payer authorization response lost, final user signature never arrives, intent later submitted
cases.assertion: Liability held until actual protocol settlement/expiry; no duplicate signature or false refund

cases.scenario: Native fee token versus USDm/unexpected token or payment recipient
cases.assertion: Native-only accepted after qualification; unsupported alternative refused before signature

cases.scenario: Safe consumption followed by transfer or namespace authority expiry
cases.assertion: Consumed proof persists; holder and resolution eligibility separate

cases.scenario: Equal grant signer/submitter or exhausted namespace/community lifetime cap
cases.assertion: Actual claim rejected; no refill or paid/short-name fallback

cases.scenario: Reserved/premium/short label, zero quote mismatch or maxCost nonzero
cases.assertion: No free grant issued; real reservations preserved

cases.scenario: Non-holder or repeated out-of-window permissionless renewal request
cases.assertion: Sponsor refuses without changing contract's permissionless zero/paid renewal semantics

cases.scenario: Admin refresh followed by TTL expiry with no new event
cases.assertion: Resolution/discovery changes at evaluation time; ownership/history/consumption unchanged

cases.scenario: Current immutable registry: configuration changes, stale evidence or authority refresh during grant collection
cases.assertion: Correct invalidation/refusal; no stale authority acceptance

cases.scenario: Only offline admin available for daily refresh
cases.assertion: Finite manual rehearsal documented; unattended service not marked ready

cases.scenario: Deployment and representative exact-call estimates on actual chain6343
cases.assertion: Source/tool/runtime/state pins and estimate recorded; mainnet table not assumed

cases.scenario: Successful and reverted operations with optional L1 fee fields
cases.assertion: Gas component, raw extras, payer payment and net debit reconciled without double count

cases.scenario: Faucet/network mismatch, safe tag unavailable or low pending balance
cases.assertion: Refuse funding instructions/signing respectively; no fallback chain or guessed fee

cases.scenario: New/existing storage, max admitted data and recurring attestations
cases.assertion: Per-flow sample set, setup/recurring separation; no percentile from one sample

cases.scenario: Duplicate/out-of-order/backfilled and orphaned logs
cases.assertion: Idempotent canonical view with safe cursor; rejected reorg cursor

cases.scenario: Configuration/publisher revocation and missing manifest/revision
cases.assertion: Authenticated complete history or refusal; aggregate excludes ineligible community

cases.scenario: Attestation/name expiry without logs and holder transfer
cases.assertion: Query-time temporal eligibility; ownership and permanent receipts preserved

cases.scenario: 17UTC boundary, gaps, duplicates, corrections/invalidation, ties and eligibility changes
cases.assertion: Exact parity with pinned reference semantics at fixed evaluation timestamp

cases.scenario: Low float, provider outage, paused community/global policy
cases.assertion: No new signatures; alerts and original reconciliation continue safely

cases.scenario: Try each service principal against other two signing secret scopes
cases.assertion: Denied access; community Worker has no central signer secret

cases.scenario: Pending/active/paused eligibility, usage versus reserved fees
cases.assertion: No top-up/key form or invented quota; status reflects actual authoritative readiness

cases.scenario: Pure refresh matches admitted authority identity/epoch and current configuration while a grant is being signed
cases.assertion: Freshness sequence changes but claim-bound semantic authority revision does not; otherwise valid original grant survives

cases.scenario: Owner/scope/policy transition, suspension or delegated-attester revocation
cases.assertion: Semantic revision invalidates old grants; revocation clears usable freshness in the same transition without changing holder rights

cases.scenario: Attester tries to revive expired or suspended namespace/community
cases.assertion: Refuse; admin revival requires fresh evidence/new semantic revision; monotonic time and bounded lifetime still enforced

cases.scenario: Delegated key attempts new admission, issuance enable, policy/cap/treasury/admin change or false in-scope freshness
cases.assertion: Forbidden powers refused; in-scope oracle trust explicitly retained and observable until admin revocation

cases.scenario: Lowest backend nonce stalls while several communities request new work
cases.assertion: Pause new signing for sender and bound queue; original receipt observation continues; no alternate sender/route/new nonce

cases.environment: local sender and real budget object
cases.scenario: Approved same-nonce fee bump competes for protected recovery headroom
cases.assertion: Exact original retained; only approved fee/gas fields change; atomic group maxima/category deltas commit before sign; no normal community refill or unlimited override

cases.scenario: Cancellation, reverted replacement or foreign transaction consumes original sender nonce at safe block
cases.assertion: Never label original consumed/successful; prove bytes/hash/sender/nonce/ancestry, account for fees and pause on unrecognized spend

cases.scenario: Settlement released unused original liability then consuming transaction becomes noncanonical
cases.assertion: Invalidate outcome and reinstate liabilities; pause new signing on insufficient headroom; no automatic reissue

cases.scenario: Pending/latest nonce rises, block/transaction missing, or another sender has matching event
cases.assertion: No displacement proof or release; retain exact original reservation and unavailable state

cases.scenario: Claim deadline expires before proposed replacement or while original remains signed
cases.assertion: Cannot change claim/consent to rescue; application expiry alone does not free gas liability of a still-mineable transaction

cases.scenario: Valid issuer grant and recipient consent for first claim; no existing username or general membership entry
cases.assertion: Use exact grant entitlement plus pilot admission and contract checks; no circular name gate or second membership store

cases.scenario: Holder/record manager/NFT operator/controller has some valid rights but wrong action, installation or community attribution
cases.assertion: Only actual method permissions and exact pilot constraints qualify; approval for one right is not all rights

cases.scenario: Admitted wallet transfers name to a wallet absent from pilot list
cases.assertion: Contract transfer rights unchanged; later sponsorship refused for unlisted wallet without inventing production transfer membership

cases.scenario: Signed-in learner has pending valid consent but no on-chain authorization yet; withdrawal occurs or signature is replayed
cases.assertion: Permit correctly verified first-authorization bootstrap only; wrong community/origin/contract/revocation/replay refused; never call consent joining

cases.scenario: Known revert at selected safe state versus successful simulation followed by state change before inclusion
cases.assertion: Known revert refused before reservation; later actual revert charged; simulation is not final permission or fee success

cases.scenario: Merchant helper succeeds while Pirate RPC holder/controller/role read is missing, stale or mismatched
cases.assertion: Pirate performs independent canonical-safe action checks; helper has no authority to bypass them

cases.scenario: Relay outage before/after possible broadcast or payment-authorization response loss
cases.assertion: Preserve exact final intent and unknown fee liability; no automatic refund, replacement or cross-route replay

cases.scenario: Actual initialized/fresh MOSS nested consent signatures differ in length and account path
cases.assertion: Record actual signature/calldata bytes, estimate, receipt and payer debit; no EOA signature proxy for measured cost

cases.environment: real budget object and local chain
cases.scenario: Wallet repeatedly causes preflight failures or included reverts while community has headroom
cases.assertion: Atomic configured rate/revert-cost controls apply; included reverts remain charged and cannot be reset by retry/another name

cases.scenario: Observed unit fee changes; generous estimate bounds contend under concurrency
cases.assertion: Explicit multiplier/absolute per-flow bound and expiry enforced; no invented default, silent ceiling increase or count-only cap

cases.scenario: Safe settled operation has unused reservation while another has unknown extra fees
cases.assertion: Release only proven unused liability promptly; unknown retains bound; no double refund across retries

cases.scenario: Member starts without a name or needs original recovery/renewal to repair expiry
cases.assertion: Initial claim, authentication, recovery and defined remediation avoid circular gating; fee and action checks still apply

cases.scenario: Gated UI/API action after transfer/expiry or unavailable authority
cases.assertion: Apply explicit current-holder/community rule consistently; pilot admission stays independent; prior history remains

cases.scenario: Wallet holds several names, changes primary display name and later acquires another
cases.assertion: Any qualifying name can satisfy selected-feature gate; wallet/history stable; extra names do not multiply gas allowance or free entitlement

cases.scenario: New attester or paid-issuance code proposed against immutable deployed registry
cases.assertion: No in-place upgrade claim or silent repointing; new source/ABI and exclusive uniqueness/holder-terms migration required before relied-upon adoption

cases.scenario: New or replacement issuer module attempts duplicate active name, cap reset, old-holder overwrite, altered locked terms or unapproved scope
cases.assertion: Immutable core enforces shared invariants across every issuer; paid/short-name policy specified separately; no assumed migration freeze or unlimited mint permission

cases.environment: real budget object and local chain
cases.scenario: Original B10, fee bump12 and cancellation4, then a smaller new attempt
cases.assertion: Global reservation12 once, community/ordinary10, recovery4; smaller attempt cannot lower maxima while prior one remains executable; settle actual outcome once

cases.scenario: Community A is at its normal cap and holds a stuck sender nonce while B/C need service
cases.assertion: Approved bump/cancel can use protected Pirate recovery headroom without new A allowance; same sender actually has required native balance; bounded unblocking preserves original identity

cases.scenario: Different nonce/sender, MOSS intent or independently payable relay fee is offered for maximum grouping
cases.assertion: Refuse grouping; additive independent liabilities remain; at most one canonical direct transaction is not a general fee exclusivity claim

cases.scenario: Two manual approvals race on same group or last global recovery capacity; signer response is lost
cases.assertion: Complete prior revision/attempt-set CAS admits compatible serialized state only; all potentially signed attempts remain bounded and journalled

cases.scenario: Normal requests attempt to use protected headroom, or recovery budget exists but sender cash is inadequate
cases.assertion: Normal request cannot consume recovery partition/float; missing cash/ceiling triggers truthful pause, no automatic treasury transfer

cases.scenario: Admin atomically revokes compromised attester and submits fresh evidence; repeat with invalid evidence/configuration
cases.assertion: Successful call changes semantic revision once and retains fresh service; invalid combined call reverts entirely; standalone urgent revocation still works

cases.scenario: Exact fixed-price purchase versus changed quote, wrong asset/value, fee-on-transfer debit and failed receiver
cases.assertion: Only configured exact buyer payment succeeds; protocol payment and mint roll back together on failure; no overpayment escrow or free-path paid fallback

cases.scenario: Buyer equals recipient versus gift recipient, with MOSS gas payer distinct or forged buyer identity
cases.assertion: Exact recipient consent always required in proposed profile; core caller is buyer, sponsor is not buyer; altering recipient/domain/terms refuses

cases.scenario: Atomic holder export/import succeeds or fails, while duplicate mint/nonparticipating holder/lineage-loop is attempted
cases.assertion: One authoritative name, exact holder/terms/history preserved; failure rolls back; no source re-registration or invented export capability in Registry56

cases.scenario: Third party repeatedly renews a locked zero-price generation and policy later changes
cases.assertion: No implied sunset or ownership change; existing terms preserved; sponsorship remains separately limited and new zero policy explicit

cases.scenario: Canonical positive/negative TLD/label vectors including ab--cd, xn--, terminators, single hyphens and1/8/63/64 lengths
cases.assertion: Directory/core/modules/SDK agree on common validator; free minimum8 and explicitly configured paid-short policy are distinct

cases.scenario: Tester starts first claim or someone tries to promote disposable deployment into real community routing
cases.assertion: Disposable/no-production-entitlement notice acknowledged before claim; no promised automatic carry-over, asset deletion or silent source adoption

deliveryNote: All previous72 IDs retained. SUB-02 now tests the revised group/recovery accounting instead of sum-of-attempts. Twelve new cases are UNRUN plans. Earlier restore scenarios remain deferred. Successor/module/exit/purchase behavior is proposed, not present in accepted contracts.
